title: Section 138 NI Act — Dishonour of cheque for insufficiency of funds

content.overview: Section 138 makes it an offence when a cheque drawn for discharge of a debt or other liability is returned unpaid for insufficiency of funds or because it exceeds the arrangement with the bank, after the statutory notice and failure to pay within fifteen days.
content.study: Build the offence step by step: legally enforceable debt or liability, cheque presented within validity, bank return for the stated reasons, payee's written demand within thirty days of intimation, and drawer's failure to pay within fifteen days of receipt of notice. Pair with section 139 (presumption) and section 142 (cognizance and limitation).
